claim: The default quota is 300 nodes per Region across all clusters, and it is adjustable through Service Quotas.
question: Quotas: how many nodes per Region, and is the quota adjustable?

qualifiers.scope: per Region, per account, nodes across all clusters

note: The guide page quota-limits describes this quota as applying to non-reserved nodes only; the General Reference row says reserved and non-reserved. The claim keeps to the number and adjustability both pages share.
